question_en: Provide the related post title of "How to tell if something happened in a data set which monitors a value over time".
question_ar: قدم عنوان المنشور ذي الصلة (related post title) لـ "How to tell if something happened in a data set which monitors a value over time".
SQL: SELECT T3.Title FROM postLinks AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T1.RelatedPostId = T3.Id WHERE T2.Title = 'How to tell if something happened in a data set which monitors a value over time'

question_en: List the post IDs and badge names of the user Samuel in 2013.
question_ar: اذكر معرّفات المنشورات (post IDs) وأسماء الشارات للمستخدم Samuel في عام 2013.
evidence_en: Samuel refers to UserDisplayName; YEAR(CreationDate) = 2013 relates to PostId; YEAR(Date) = 2013 relates to the badge;
evidence_ar: Samuel يشير إلى اسم عرض المستخدم (UserDisplayName)؛ سنة(تاريخ الإنشاء) = 2013 تتعلق بمعرّف المنشور؛ سنة(تاريخ) = 2013 تتعلق بالشارة؛
SQL: SELECT T1.PostId, T2.Name FROM postHistory AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.UserId WHERE T1.UserDisplayName = 'Samuel' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2013' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '2013'

question_en: What is the owner's display name of the most popular post?
question_ar: ما هو اسم العرض (display name) للمالك للمنشور الأكثر شعبية (most popular post)؟
evidence_en: Higher view count means the post has higher popularity; the most popular post refers to MAX(ViewCount);
evidence_ar: عدد مشاهدات أعلى يعني أن المنشور يتمتع بشعبية أكبر؛ المنشور الأكثر شعبية يشير إلى MAX(ViewCount)؛
SQL: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Id = ( SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts ORDER BY ViewCount DESC LIMIT 1 )

question_en: Mention the display name and location of the user who owned the excerpt post with hypothesis-testing tag.
question_ar: اذكر اسم العرض (display name) والموقع (location) للمستخدم الذي يمتلك المنشور المقتبس (excerpt post) الذي يحمل الوسم hypothesis-testing.
evidence_en: user who owned the excerpt post with hypothesis-testing tag refers to OwnerUserId WHERE TagName = 'hypothesis-testing';
evidence_ar: المستخدم الذي يمتلك المنشور المقتبس مع الوسم hypothesis-testing يشير إلى OwnerUserId حيث TagName = 'hypothesis-testing'؛
SQL: SELECT T3.DisplayName, T3.Location FROM tags AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.ExcerptPostId = T2.Id INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.TagName = 'hypothesis-testing'

question_en: Write down the related posts titles and link type IDs of the post "What are principal component scores?".
question_ar: اكتب عناوين المنشورات ذات الصلة ومعرّفات نوع الرابط (link type IDs) للمنشور "What are principal component scores?".
evidence_en: Title = 'What are principal component scores?';
evidence_ar: العنوان (Title) = 'What are principal component scores?'؛
SQL: SELECT T3.Title, T2.LinkTypeId FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN postLinks AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.RelatedPostId = T3.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'What are principal component scores?'

question_en: Describe the display name of the parent ID for child post with the highest score.
question_ar: صف اسم العرض لمعرّف الأب (parent ID) للمنشور الفرعي (child post) الذي حصل على أعلى تقييم (highest score).
evidence_en: If the parent id is not null, the post is the child post; the highest score refers to MAX(Score);
evidence_ar: إذا كان معرّف الأب ليس فارغًا، فإن المنشور هو منشور فرعي؛ أعلى تقييم يشير إلى MAX(Score)؛
SQL: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Id = ( SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE ParentId IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Score DESC LIMIT 1 )

question_en: Under the vote type of 8, provide the display names and websites URLs of the user who got the highest bounty amount.
question_ar: تحت نوع التصويت 8، قدم أسماء العرض وروابط المواقع الإلكترونية (websites URLs) للمستخدم الذي حصل على أعلى مبلغ مكافأة (highest bounty amount).
evidence_en: vote type of 8 refers to VoteTypeId = 8; the highest bounty amount refers to MAX(BountyAmount);
evidence_ar: نوع التصويت 8 يشير إلى VoteTypeId = 8؛ أعلى مبلغ مكافأة يشير إلى MAX(BountyAmount)؛
SQL: SELECT DisplayName, WebsiteUrl FROM users WHERE Id = ( SELECT UserId FROM votes WHERE VoteTypeId = 8 ORDER BY BountyAmount DESC LIMIT 1 )

question_en: What are the titles of the top 5 posts with the highest popularity?
question_ar: ما هي عناوين (titles) أفضل 5 منشورات تحظى بأعلى شعبية (highest popularity)؟
evidence_en: Higher view count means the post has higher popularity; the highest popularity refers to MAX(ViewCount);
evidence_ar: عدد مشاهدات أعلى يعني شعبية أكبر؛ أعلى شعبية تشير إلى ترتيب تنازلي حسب ViewCount؛
SQL: SELECT Title FROM posts ORDER BY ViewCount DESC LIMIT 5

question_en: How many tags have post count between 5,000 to 7,000?
question_ar: كم عدد الوسوم (tags) التي يتراوح عدد منشوراتها بين 5,000 و 7,000؟
evidence_en: post count between 5,000 to 7,000 refers to Count BETWEEN 5000 and 7000;
evidence_ar: عدد المنشورات بين 5,000 و 7,000 يشير إلى Count BETWEEN 5000 and 7000؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM tags WHERE Count BETWEEN 5000 AND 7000

question_en: What is the owner user id of the most valuable post?
question_ar: ما هو معرّف المستخدم المالك (owner user id) للمنشور الأكثر قيمة (most valuable post)؟
evidence_en: the most valuable post refers to MAX(FavoriteCount);
evidence_ar: المنشور الأكثر قيمة يشير إلى MAX(FavoriteCount) (أكبر عدد من التفضيلات)؛
SQL: SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE FavoriteCount = ( SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts )

question_en: How old is the most influential user?
question_ar: كم عمر المستخدم الأكثر تأثيرًا (most influential user)؟
evidence_en: How old describes age; the most influential refers to user where MAX(Reputation);
evidence_ar: كم عمر تصف العمر (age)؛ المستخدم الأكثر تأثيرًا يشير إلى المستخدم الذي يمتلك أعلى سمعة MAX(Reputation)؛
SQL: SELECT Age FROM users WHERE Reputation = ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users )

question_en: How many posts with votes that were created in 2011 have a bounty of 50?
question_ar: كم عدد المنشورات التي تحتوي على تصويتات والتي تم إنشاؤها في عام 2011 ولديها مكافأة (bounty) قدرها 50؟
evidence_en: created in 2012 refers YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011; BountyAmount = 50;
evidence_ar: تم إنشاؤها في 2011 تشير إلى YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011 (ملاحظة: الدليل يذكر 2012 كخطأ مطبعي)؛ مبلغ المكافأة = 50؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T2.BountyAmount = 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.CreationDate) = '2011'

question_en: What is the id of the youngest user?
question_ar: ما هو معرّف (id) أصغر مستخدم (youngest user)؟
evidence_en: the youngest user refers to MIN(Age);
evidence_ar: أصغر مستخدم يشير إلى الحد الأدنى للعمر MIN(Age)؛
SQL: SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Age = ( SELECT MIN(Age) FROM users )

question_en: What is the sum of score of the post on 2010-07-19?
question_ar: ما هو مجموع تقييمات (sum of score) المنشور في 2010-07-19؟
evidence_en: on 2010-07-19 refers to LasActivityDate LIKE '2010-07-19%';
evidence_ar: في 2010-07-19 يشير إلى LastActivityDate LIKE '2010-07-19%'؛ (ملاحظة: الاستعلام يستخدم LasActivityDate)
SQL: SELECT SUM(Score) FROM posts WHERE LasActivityDate LIKE '2010-07-19%'

question_en: What is the average monthly number of links created in 2010 for posts that have no more than 2 answers?
question_ar: ما هو متوسط العدد الشهري للروابط (links) التي تم إنشاؤها في عام 2010 للمنشورات التي لا تحتوي على أكثر من إجابتين؟
evidence_en: calculation = DIVIDE(COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010 and AnswerCount < = 2), 12)
evidence_ar: الحساب = القسمة(عدد(Id حيث السنة(CreationDate) = 2010 و AnswerCount <= 2), 12)
SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.Id) AS REAL) / 12 FROM postLinks AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.AnswerCount <= 2 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2010'

question_en: Among the posts that were voted by user 1465, what is the id of the most valuable post?
question_ar: من بين المنشورات التي تم التصويت عليها من قبل المستخدم 1465، ما هو معرّف (id) المنشور الأكثر قيمة (most valuable post)؟
evidence_en: user 1465 refers to UserId = 1465; the most valuable post refers to MAX(FavoriteCount);
evidence_ar: المستخدم 1465 يشير إلى UserId = 1465؛ المنشور الأكثر قيمة يشير إلى أعلى عدد تفضيلات (FavoriteCount)؛
SQL: SELECT T2.Id FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.UserId = 1465 ORDER BY T2.FavoriteCount DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: What is the title of the post with the oldest post link?
question_ar: ما هو عنوان المنشور الذي يحتوي على أقدم رابط منشور (oldest post link)؟
evidence_en: the oldest post link refers to MIN(CreaionDate);
evidence_ar: أقدم رابط منشور يشير إلى أقدم تاريخ إنشاء (CreationDate)؛
SQL: SELECT T1.Title FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN postLinks AS T2 ON T2.PostId = T1.Id ORDER BY T1.CreaionDate LIMIT 1

question_en: What is the display name of the user who acquired the highest amount of badges?
question_ar: ما هو اسم العرض للمستخدم الذي حصل على أكبر عدد من الشارات (badges)؟
evidence_en: highest amount of badges refers to MAX(COUNT(Name));
evidence_ar: أكبر عدد من الشارات يشير إلى الترتيب التنازلي لعدد الشارات لكل مستخدم؛
SQL: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId GROUP BY T1.DisplayName ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Id) DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: When did 'chl' cast its first vote in a post?
question_ar: متى أدلى 'chl' بأول تصويت له في منشور؟
evidence_en: DisplayName = 'chl'; cast its first vote refers to MIN(CreationDate);
evidence_ar: اسم العرض = 'chl'؛ أول تصويت يشير إلى أقدم تاريخ إنشاء للتصويت MIN(CreationDate)؛
SQL: SELECT T2.CreationDate FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'chl' ORDER BY T2.CreationDate LIMIT 1

question_en: What is the date when the youngest user made his or her first post?
question_ar: ما هو التاريخ الذي قام فيه أصغر مستخدم (youngest user) بإنشاء أول منشور له؟
evidence_en: the youngest user refers to MIN(Age); first post refers to MIN(CreaionDate);
evidence_ar: أصغر مستخدم يشير إلى الترتيب التصاعدي للعمر؛ أول منشور يشير إلى الترتيب التصاعدي لتاريخ الإنشاء؛
SQL: SELECT T2.CreaionDate FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.Age IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.Age, T2.CreaionDate LIMIT 1

question_en: What is the display name of the user who acquired the first Autobiographer badge?
question_ar: ما هو اسم العرض للمستخدم الذي حصل على أول شارة Autobiographer (كاتب سيرة ذاتية)؟
evidence_en: Autobiographer is the name of the badge; acquired the first refers to MIN(Date);
evidence_ar: Autobiographer هو اسم الشارة؛ الحصول على الأولى يشير إلى أقدم تاريخ (Date)؛
SQL: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.`Name` = 'Autobiographer' ORDER BY T2.Date LIMIT 1

question_en: Among the users located in United Kingdom, how many users whose post have a total favorite amount of 4 or more?
question_ar: من بين المستخدمين الموجودين في المملكة المتحدة (United Kingdom)، كم عدد المستخدمين الذين بلغ إجمالي عدد التفضيلات لمنشوراتهم 4 أو أكثر؟
evidence_en: favorite amount of 4 or more refers to FavoriteCount > = 4; Location = 'United Kingdom';
evidence_ar: عدد التفضيلات 4 أو أكثر يشير إلى FavoriteCount >= 4؛ الموقع = 'United Kingdom'؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.Location = 'United Kingdom' AND T2.FavoriteCount >= 4

question_en: What is the average number of posts voted by the oldest users?
question_ar: ما هو متوسط عدد المنشورات التي صوّت عليها أكبر المستخدمين سناً (oldest users)؟
evidence_en: average number of posts voted refers to AVG(PostId) FROM votes; the oldest users refer to MAX(Age);
evidence_ar: متوسط عدد المنشورات المصوت عليها (ملاحظة: الاستعلام يحسب متوسط معرّفات المنشورات وهو أمر غير منطقي دلاليًا، لكن هذا هو الاستعلام المتوفر) يشير إلى AVG(PostId) من جدول votes؛ أكبر المستخدمين سناً يشير إلى المستخدمين ذوي الحد الأقصى للعمر MAX(Age)؛
SQL: SELECT AVG(PostId) FROM votes WHERE UserId IN ( SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Age = ( SELECT MAX(Age) FROM users ) )

question_en: Who has the highest reputation? Please give the display name.
question_ar: من لديه أعلى سمعة (highest reputation)؟ يرجى إعطاء اسم العرض.
evidence_en: the highest reputation refers to MAX(Reputation);
evidence_ar: أعلى سمعة تشير إلى MAX(Reputation)؛
SQL: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Reputation = ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users )

question_en: How many users whose reputations are higher than 2000 and the number of views is higher than 1000?
question_ar: كم عدد المستخدمين الذين تتجاوز سمعتهم 2000 وعدد مشاهداتهم أعلى من 1000؟
evidence_en: reputations are higher than 2000 refer to Reputation > 2000; number of views is higher than 1000 refers to Views > 1000;
evidence_ar: السمعة أعلى من 2000 تشير إلى Reputation > 2000؛ عدد المشاهدات أعلى من 1000 يشير إلى Views > 1000؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM users WHERE Reputation > 2000 AND Views > 1000

question_en: Please list all display names of users who are adults.
question_ar: يرجى سرد جميع أسماء العرض للمستخدمين البالغين (adults).
evidence_en: adults refer to users where Age BETWEEN 19 and 65;
evidence_ar: البالغون يشيرون إلى المستخدمين حيث يتراوح العمر (Age) بين 19 و 65؛
SQL: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65

question_en: How many posts did Jay Stevens have in 2010?
question_ar: كم عدد المنشورات التي امتلكها Jay Stevens في عام 2010؟
evidence_en: DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens'; in 2010 refers to YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010;
evidence_ar: اسم العرض = 'Jay Stevens'؛ في عام 2010 يشير إلى السنة(تاريخ الإنشاء) = 2010؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.CreaionDate) = '2010' AND T1.DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens'

question_en: Which post by Harvey Motulsky has the most views? Please give the id and title of this post.
question_ar: أي منشور لـ Harvey Motulsky حصد أكبر عدد من المشاهدات (most views)؟ يرجى إعطاء معرّف وعنوان هذا المنشور.
evidence_en: DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'; the most views refer to MAX(ViewCount);
evidence_ar: اسم العرض = 'Harvey Motulsky'؛ أكبر عدد مشاهدات يشير إلى الترتيب التنازلي حسب ViewCount؛
SQL: SELECT T2.Id, T2.Title FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' ORDER BY T2.ViewCount DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: Which post has the highest score? Please give its id and title's name.
question_ar: أي منشور حصل على أعلى تقييم (highest score)؟ يرجى إعطاء معرّفه واسم عنوانه.
evidence_en: the highest score refers to MAX(Score); owner's name refers to DisplayName;
evidence_ar: أعلى تقييم يشير إلى الترتيب التنازلي حسب التقييم (Score)؛
SQL: SELECT T1.Id, T2.Title FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId ORDER BY T2.Score DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: What is the average score of Stephen Turner's posts?
question_ar: ما هو متوسط تقييم (average score) منشورات Stephen Turner؟
evidence_en: DisplayName = 'Stephen Turner'; average score refers to AVG(Score);
evidence_ar: اسم العرض = 'Stephen Turner'؛ متوسط التقييم يشير إلى AVG(Score)؛
SQL: SELECT AVG(T2.Score) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Stephen Turner'

question_en: How many superheroes have blue eyes?
question_ar: كم عدد الأبطال الخارقين (superheroes) ذوي العيون الزرقاء؟
evidence_en: blue eyes refers to colour = 'Blue' and eye_colour_id = colour.id;
evidence_ar: عيون زرقاء تشير إلى colour = 'Blue' و eye_colour_id = colour.id؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue'

question_en: What is the colour of Apocalypse's skin?
question_ar: ما هو لون بشرة (skin colour) أبكليبس (Apocalypse)؟
evidence_en: Apocalypse refers to superhero_name = 'Apocalypse'; colour of skin refers to colour where skin_colour_id = colour.id
evidence_ar: Apocalypse تشير إلى superhero_name = 'Apocalypse'؛ لون البشرة يشير إلى colour حيث skin_colour_id = colour.id
SQL: SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Apocalypse'

question_en: Among the superheroes with blue eyes, how many of them have the super power of "Agility"?
question_ar: من بين الأبطال الخارقين ذوي العيون الزرقاء، كم عددهم الذين لديهم قوة خارقة (super power) هي "Agility" (الرشاقة)؟
evidence_en: blue eyes refers to colour = 'Blue' and eye_colour_id = colour.id; super power of "Agility" refers to power_name = 'Agility'
evidence_ar: عيون زرقاء تشير إلى colour = 'Blue' و eye_colour_id = colour.id؛ قوة خارقة "Agility" تشير إلى power_name = 'Agility'
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id INNER JOIN colour AS T4 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T4.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Agility' AND T4.colour = 'Blue'

question_en: Please list the superhero names of all the superheroes that have blue eyes and blond hair.
question_ar: يرجى سرد أسماء الأبطال الخارقين لجميع الأبطال الذين لديهم عيون زرقاء وشعر أشقر (blond hair).
evidence_en: blue eyes refers to colour = 'Blue' and eye_colour_id = colour.id; blond hair refers to colour = 'Blond' and hair_colour_id = colour.id; super power of "Agility" refers to power_name = 'Agility'
evidence_ar: عيون زرقاء تشير إلى colour = 'Blue' و eye_colour_id = colour.id؛ شعر أشقر يشير إلى colour = 'Blond' و hair_colour_id = colour.id
SQL: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Blond'

question_en: How many superheroes are published by Marvel Comics?
question_ar: كم عدد الأبطال الخارقين الذين تنشرهم شركة Marvel Comics؟
evidence_en: published by Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
evidence_ar: تنشرهم شركة Marvel Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

question_en: Rank heroes published by Marvel Comics by their height in descending order.
question_ar: قم بتصنيف (Rank) الأبطال الخارقين الذين تنشرهم شركة Marvel Comics حسب طولهم (height) بترتيب تنازلي.
evidence_en: name refers to superhero_name; the tallest hero refers to MAX(height_cm); published by Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
evidence_ar: الاسم يشير إلى superhero_name؛ الأطول يشير إلى MAX(height_cm)؛ تنشرهم Marvel Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
SQL: SELECT superhero_name, height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS HeightRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

question_en: Who is the publisher of Sauron?
question_ar: من هو ناشر (publisher) بطل Sauron؟
evidence_en: the publisher refers to publisher_name; Sauron refers to superhero_name = 'Sauron'
evidence_ar: الناشر يشير إلى publisher_name؛ Sauron تشير إلى superhero_name = 'Sauron'
SQL: SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Sauron'

question_en: Rank superheroes from Marvel Comics by their eye color popularity, starting with the most common color.
question_ar: قم بتصنيف الأبطال الخارقين من Marvel Comics حسب شعبية (popularity) لون عيونهم، بدءًا باللون الأكثر شيوعًا.
evidence_en: the superheroes from Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; most common color refers to COUNT(superhero.id) DESC;
evidence_ar: الأبطال الخارقين من Marvel Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'؛ اللون الأكثر شيوعًا يشير إلى COUNT(superhero.id) DESC؛
SQL: SELECT colour.colour AS EyeColor, COUNT(superhero.id) AS Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(superhero.id) DESC) AS PopularityRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' GROUP BY colour.colour

question_en: What is the average height of the superheroes from Marvel Comics?
question_ar: ما هو متوسط الطول (average height) للأبطال الخارقين من Marvel Comics؟
evidence_en: superheroes from Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; average height of the superheroes refers to AVG(height_cm)
evidence_ar: الأبطال الخارقين من Marvel Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'؛ متوسط الطول يشير إلى AVG(height_cm)
SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

question_en: List the superheroes from Marvel Comics who have the super power of 'Super Strength'.
question_ar: اذكر الأبطال الخارقين من Marvel Comics الذين لديهم قوة خارقة (super power) هي 'Super Strength' (القوة الخارقة).
evidence_en: the superheroes from Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; super power of "Super Strength" refers to power_name = 'Super Strength';
evidence_ar: الأبطال الخارقين من Marvel Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'؛ قوة 'Super Strength' تشير إلى power_name = 'Super Strength'؛
SQL: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS T2 INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Super Strength' AND T1.id = T2.hero_id)AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publisher AS T4 WHERE T4.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND T1.publisher_id = T4.id)

question_en: How many superheroes did DC Comics publish?
question_ar: كم عدد الأبطال الخارقين الذين نشرتهم شركة DC Comics؟
evidence_en: superheroes that DC Comics published refers to publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
evidence_ar: الأبطال الخارقين الذين نشرتهم DC Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'

question_en: Which publisher published the slowest superhero?
question_ar: أي ناشر (publisher) نشر البطل الخارق الأبطأ (slowest superhero)؟
evidence_en: the slowest superhero refers to attribute_name = 'Speed' where MIN(attribute_value); publisher refers to publisher_name
evidence_ar: البطل الخارق الأبطأ يشير إلى attribute_name = 'Speed' حيث MIN(attribute_value)؛ الناشر يشير إلى publisher_name
SQL: SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3.attribute_id = T4.id WHERE T4.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY T3.attribute_value LIMIT 1

question_en: How many gold-eyed superheroes did Marvel Comics publish?
question_ar: كم عدد الأبطال الخارقين ذوي العيون الذهبية (gold-eyed) الذين نشرتهم شركة Marvel Comics؟
evidence_en: gold-eyed refers to colour = 'Gold' where eye_colour_id = colour.id; superheroes that Marvel Comics published refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
evidence_ar: ذوو العيون الذهبية تشير إلى colour = 'Gold' حيث eye_colour_id = colour.id؛ الأبطال الخارقين الذين نشرتهم Marvel Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

question_en: What is the percentage of superheroes who act in their own self-interest or make decisions based on their own moral code? Indicate how many of the said superheroes were published by Marvel Comics.

evidence_en: published by Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; superheroes who act in their own self-interest or make decisions based on their own moral code refers to alignment = 'Bad'; calculation = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(alignment = 'Bad); count(id)), 100)
evidence_ar: نشرتهم Marvel Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'؛ الأبطال الذين يتصرفون لمصلحتهم الشخصية أو بناءً على قانونهم الأخلاقي الخاص تشير إلى alignment = 'Bad'؛
SQL: SELECT (CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero)), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T3.id = T1.alignment_id WHERE T3.alignment = 'Bad'

SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id

question_en: What is the percentage of blue female superheroes among all female superheroes?
question_ar: ما هي نسبة البطلات الخارقات (الإناث) الزرقاوات (blue) من بين جميع البطلات الخارقات؟
evidence_en: percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(colour = 'Blue' WHERE gender = 'Female'), COUNT(gender = 'Female')), 100); blue refers to the color = 'Blue' WHERE skin_colour_id = colour.id; female refers to gender = 'Female';
evidence_ar: النسبة المئوية = ضرب(قسمة(مجموع(colour = 'Blue' حيث gender = 'Female'), عدد(gender = 'Female')), 100)؛ الزرقاء تشير إلى اللون = 'Blue' حيث skin_colour_id = colour.id؛ الإناث تشير إلى gender = 'Female'؛
SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.colour = 'Blue' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'

question_en: Find the ratio between male superheroes and female superheroes.

question_en: Give the alignment and superpowers of the superhero named Atom IV.
question_ar: أعطِ الانتماء والقوى الخارقة للبطل الخارق المسمى Atom IV.
evidence_en: superpowers refers to power_name;
evidence_ar: القوى الخارقة تشير إلى power_name؛
SQL: SELECT T4.alignment, T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T3.id = T2.power_id INNER JOIN alignment AS T4 ON T1.alignment_id = T4.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Atom IV'

question_en: List down at least five full names of superheroes with blue eyes.
question_ar: اذكر خمسة أسماء كاملة على الأقل لأبطال خارقين ذوي عيون زرقاء.
evidence_en: blue eyes refers to colour.colour = 'Blue' WHERE eye_colour_id = colour.id; Name of superheroes refers to superhero_name;
evidence_ar: العيون الزرقاء تشير إلى colour.colour = 'Blue' حيث eye_colour_id = colour.id؛ أسماء الأبطال الخارقين تشير إلى superhero_name؛
SQL: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' LIMIT 5

question_en: Calculate the average attribute value of all neutral superheroes.
question_ar: احسب متوسط قيمة السمة لجميع الأبطال الخارقين المحايدين.
evidence_en: average = AVG(attribute_value); neutral superheroes refers to alignment_id = 3;
evidence_ar: المتوسط = AVG(attribute_value)؛ الأبطال الخارقون المحايدون يشيرون إلى alignment_id = 3؛
SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute AS T1 INNER JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.hero_id = T2.id INNER JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T2.alignment_id = T3.id WHERE T3.alignment = 'Neutral'

question_en: List the skin colour of the superheroes with 100 attribute value.
question_ar: اذكر لون بشرة الأبطال الخارقين الذين تبلغ قيمة سمتهم 100.
evidence_en: skin colour refers to colour.colour where skin_colour_id = colour.id; 100 attribute value refers to attribute_value = 100;
evidence_ar: لون البشرة يشير إلى colour.colour حيث skin_colour_id = colour.id؛ قيمة سمة 100 تشير إلى attribute_value = 100؛
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.hero_id WHERE T3.attribute_value = 100

question_en: Count the good female superheroes.
question_ar: احسب عدد البطلات الخارقات من النوع 'الخيرة' (Good).
evidence_en: good refers to alignment.id = 1; female refers to gender.id = 2;
evidence_ar: خيرة تشير إلى alignment.id = 1؛ أنثى تشير إلى gender.id = 2؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Good' AND T3.gender = 'Female'

question_en: Provide the names of superheroes with attribute value between 75 to 80.
question_ar: قدم أسماء الأبطال الخارقين الذين تتراوح قيمة سمتهم بين 75 و 80.
evidence_en: names of superheroes refers to superhero_name; attribute value between 75 to 80 refers to attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;
evidence_ar: أسماء الأبطال الخارقين تشير إلى superhero_name؛ قيمة سمة بين 75 و 80 تشير إلى attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80؛
SQL: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80

question_en: Give the race of the blue-haired male superhero.
question_ar: أعطِ عرق البطل الخارق الذكر ذو الشعر الأزرق.
evidence_en: blue-haired refers to colour.colour = 'blue' WHERE hair_colour_id = colour.id; male refers to gender = 'male';
evidence_ar: شعر أزرق يشير إلى colour.colour = 'blue' حيث hair_colour_id = colour.id؛ ذكر يشير إلى gender = 'male'؛
SQL: SELECT T3.race FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1.race_id = T3.id INNER JOIN gender AS T4 ON T1.gender_id = T4.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T4.gender = 'Male'

question_en: Among the bad superheroes, what is the percentage of female superheroes?
question_ar: من بين الأبطال الخارقين الأشرار، ما هي نسبة البطلات الخارقات (الإناث)؟
evidence_en: bad superheroes refers to alignment.id = 2; percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(gender.id = 2 WHERE alignment.id = 2), COUNT(alignment.id = 2)), 100.0); female refers to gender.id = 2;
evidence_ar: أبطال أشرار تشير إلى alignment.id = 2؛ إناث تشير إلى gender.id = 2؛
SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'Female' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Bad'

question_en: In superheroes with missing weight data, calculate the difference between the number of superheroes with blue eyes and no eye color.
question_ar: في الأبطال الخارقين الذين ليس لديهم بيانات وزن، احسب الفرق بين عدد الأبطال ذوي العيون الزرقاء والذين ليس لديهم لون عين.
evidence_en: missing weight data refers to weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg = NULL; difference = SUBTRACT(SUM(colour.id = 7), SUM(colour.id = 1)); blue eyes refers to eye_colour_id WHERE colour.id = 7; no eye color refers to eye_colour_id WHERE colour.id = 1;
evidence_ar: بيانات وزن مفقودة تشير إلى weight_kg = 0 أو weight_kg IS NULL؛ الفرق = الطرح(مجموع(العيون الزرقاء)، مجموع(بدون لون عين))؛
SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg is NULL

question_en: How strong is the Hulk?
question_ar: ما مدى قوة (strength) هالك (Hulk)؟
evidence_en: how strong refers to attribute_value WHERE attribute_name = 'Strength'; the Hulk refers to superhero_name = 'Hulk';
evidence_ar: مدى القوة يشير إلى attribute_value حيث attribute_name = 'Strength'؛ هالك يشير إلى superhero_name = 'Hulk'؛
SQL: SELECT T2.attribute_value FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND T3.attribute_name = 'Strength'

question_en: List down Ajax's superpowers.
question_ar: اذكر القوى الخارقة لـ Ajax.
evidence_en: Ajax refers to superhero_name = 'Ajax'; superpowers refers to power_name;
evidence_ar: Ajax يشير إلى superhero_name = 'Ajax'؛ القوى الخارقة تشير إلى power_name؛
SQL: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Ajax'

question_en: How many green-skinned villains are there in the superhero universe?
question_ar: كم عدد الأشرار (villains) ذوي البشرة الخضراء في عالم الأبطال الخارقين؟
evidence_en: green-skinned refers to colour.colour = 'Green' WHERE skin_colour_id = colour.id; villains refers to alignment = 'Bad';
evidence_ar: بشرة خضراء تشير إلى colour.colour = 'Green' حيث skin_colour_id = colour.id؛ الأشرار تشير إلى alignment = 'Bad'؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Bad' AND T3.colour = 'Green'

question_en: How many female superheroes are in Marvel Comics?
question_ar: كم عدد البطلات الخارقات في Marvel Comics؟
evidence_en: female refers to gender = 'Female'; Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
evidence_ar: أنثى تشير إلى gender = 'Female'؛ Marvel Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND T3.gender = 'Female'

question_en: Identify superheroes who can control wind and list their names in alphabetical order.
question_ar: حدد الأبطال الخارقين الذين يمكنهم التحكم في الرياح (Wind Control) واذكر أسماءهم بترتيب أبجدي.
evidence_en: superheroes refers to superhero_name; can control wind refers to power_name = 'Wind Control';
evidence_ar: الأبطال الخارقون يشير إلى superhero_name؛ يمكنهم التحكم في الرياح يشير إلى power_name = 'Wind Control'؛
SQL: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Wind Control' ORDER BY T1.superhero_name

question_en: Identify the gender of the superhero who has the ability of Phoenix Force.
question_ar: حدد جنس (gender) البطل الخارق الذي يمتلك قدرة Phoenix Force.
evidence_en: ability of Phoenix Force refers to power_name = 'Phoenix Force';
evidence_ar: قدرة Phoenix Force تشير إلى power_name = 'Phoenix Force'؛
SQL: SELECT T4.gender FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id INNER JOIN gender AS T4 ON T1.gender_id = T4.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'

question_en: Identify the heaviest superhero in DC Comics.
question_ar: حدد أثقل بطل خارق وزناً في DC Comics.
evidence_en: heaviest refers to MAX(weight_kg); DC Comics refers to publisher_name = 'DC Comics'; superhero refers to superhero_name;
evidence_ar: الأثقل يشير إلى MAX(weight_kg)؛ DC Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'DC Comics'؛
SQL: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' ORDER BY T1.weight_kg DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: What is the average height of a non-human superhero in Dark Horse Comics?
question_ar: ما هو متوسط طول البطل الخارق غير البشري (non-human) في Dark Horse Comics؟
evidence_en: average = AVG(height_cm); non-human superhero refers to race <> 'Human'; Dark Horse Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';
evidence_ar: المتوسط = AVG(height_cm)؛ بطل غير بشري يشير إلى العرق ليس 'Human'؛ Dark Horse Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'؛
SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1.race_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics' AND T3.race != 'Human'

question_en: Count the fastest superheroes.
question_ar: احسب عدد أسرع الأبطال الخارقين.
evidence_en: fastest refers to attribute_value = 100 WHERE attribute_name = 'Speed';
evidence_ar: الأسرع يشير إلى attribute_value = 100 حيث attribute_name = 'Speed'؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T3.superhero_name) FROM hero_attribute AS T1 INNER JOIN attribute AS T2 ON T1.attribute_id = T2.id INNER JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T1.hero_id = T3.id WHERE T2.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND T1.attribute_value = 100

question_en: Which publisher created more superheroes: DC or Marvel Comics? Find the difference in the number of superheroes.
question_ar: أي ناشر ابتكر أبطالاً خارقين أكثر: DC أم Marvel Comics؟ أوجد الفرق في عدد الأبطال الخارقين.
evidence_en: DC refers to publisher_name = 'DC Comics'; Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; difference = SUBTRACT(SUM(publisher_name = 'DC Comics'), SUM(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'));
evidence_ar: الفرق = طرح(مجموع(DC Comics)، مجموع(Marvel Comics))؛
SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id

question_en: Identify the weakest attribute of the Black Panther.
question_ar: حدد أضعف سمة (attribute) لدى النمر الأسود (Black Panther).
evidence_en: weakest attribute refers to attribute_name WHERE MIN(attribute_value); Black Panther refers to superhero_name = 'Black Panther';
evidence_ar: أضعف سمة تشير إلى ترتيب تصاعدي حسب attribute_value؛ Black Panther تشير إلى superhero_name = 'Black Panther'؛
SQL: SELECT T3.attribute_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Black Panther' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: What is Abomination's eye colour?
question_ar: ما هو لون عيون Abomination؟
evidence_en: Abomination refers to superhero_name = 'Abomination'; eye colour refers to colour.colour where eye_colour_id = colour.id;
evidence_ar: Abomination تشير إلى superhero_name = 'Abomination'؛ لون العين يشير إلى colour.colour حيث eye_colour_id = colour.id؛
SQL: SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Abomination'

question_en: Name the tallest superhero.
question_ar: سمِّ أطول بطل خارق.
evidence_en: tallest superhero refers to MAX(height_cm);
evidence_ar: أطول بطل خارق يشير إلى الترتيب التنازلي لـ height_cm؛
SQL: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero ORDER BY height_cm DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: Name the superhero, otherwise known as Charles Chandler.
question_ar: سمِّ البطل الخارق، المعروف أيضًا باسم Charles Chandler.
evidence_en: name the superhero refers to superhero_name; Charles Chandler is the full name of superhero;
evidence_ar: Charles Chandler هو الاسم الكامل للبطل الخارق؛
SQL: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'

question_en: Among all superheroes created by George Lucas, identify the percentage of female superheroes.
question_ar: من بين جميع الأبطال الخارقين الذين ابتكرهم George Lucas، حدد نسبة البطلات الخارقات (الإناث).
evidence_en: created by George Lucas refers to publisher_name = 'George Lucas'; percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(gender = 'Female' WHERE publisher_name = 'George Lucas'), COUNT(publisher_name = 'George Lucas')), 100.0); female refers to gender = 'Female';
evidence_ar: George Lucas يشير إلى publisher_name = 'George Lucas'؛ إناث تشير إلى gender = 'Female'؛ النسبة المئوية = (عدد الإناث لـ George Lucas / إجمالي أبطال George Lucas) * 100؛
SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'

question_en: Among all superheroes in Marvel Comics, identify the percentage of 'good' superheroes.
question_ar: من بين جميع الأبطال الخارقين في Marvel Comics، حدد نسبة الأبطال الخارقين 'الأخيار' (good).
evidence_en: Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(alignment = 'Good' WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'), COUNT(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')), 100.0); good superheroes refers to alignment = 'Good';
evidence_ar: Marvel Comics تشير إلى publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'؛ أخيار تشير إلى alignment = 'Good'؛ النسبة المئوية = (عدد الأخيار لـ Marvel / إجمالي أبطال Marvel) * 100؛
SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.alignment = 'Good' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T1.alignment_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

question_en: What is the total number of superheroes that have John as their first name?
question_ar: ما هو العدد الإجمالي للأبطال الخارقين الذين اسمهم الأول هو John؟
evidence_en: have John as their first name refers to full_name LIKE 'John%';
evidence_ar: الاسم الأول John يشير إلى full_name LIKE 'John%'؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%'

question_en: Give the hero ID of superhero with the lowest attribute value.
question_ar: أعطِ معرّف البطل (hero ID) للبطل الخارق صاحب أدنى قيمة سمة.
evidence_en: lowest attribute value refers to MIN(attribute_value);
evidence_ar: أدنى قيمة سمة تشير إلى MIN(attribute_value)؛
SQL: SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = ( SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute )

question_en: Provide the full name of the superhero named Alien.
question_ar: قدم الاسم الكامل للبطل الخارق المسمى Alien.
SQL: SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'

question_en: In superheroes with weight less than 100, list the full name of the superheroes with brown eyes.
question_ar: في الأبطال الخارقين الذين يقل وزنهم عن 100، اذكر الاسم الكامل للأبطال الخارقين ذوي العيون البنية.
evidence_en: weight less than 100 refers to weight_kg < 100
evidence_ar: الوزن أقل من 100 يشير إلى weight_kg < 100
SQL: SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'Brown'

question_en: List the attribute value of the superhero named Aquababy.
question_ar: اذكر قيمة السمة (attribute value) للبطل الخارق المسمى Aquababy.
SQL: SELECT T2.attribute_value FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Aquababy'

question_en: Provide the weight and race of the superhero with superhero ID 40.
question_ar: قدم وزن وعرق البطل الخارق صاحب المعرّف (ID) رقم 40.
evidence_en: weight refers to weight_kg; superhero ID 40 refers to superhero.id = 40;
evidence_ar: الوزن يشير إلى weight_kg؛ معرّف البطل 40 يشير إلى superhero.id = 40؛
SQL: SELECT T1.weight_kg, T2.race FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T1.id = 40

question_en: Calculate the average height of all neutral superheroes.
question_ar: احسب متوسط طول جميع الأبطال الخارقين المحايدين.
SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Neutral'

question_en: List the hero ID of superheroes have intellegence as their power.
question_ar: اذكر معرّف البطل (hero ID) للأبطال الخارقين الذين يمتلكون الذكاء (Intelligence) كقوة لهم.
evidence_en: hero ID refers to superhero.id; have intelligence as their power refers to power_name = 'Intelligence';
evidence_ar: معرّف البطل يشير إلى superhero.id؛ الذكاء كقوة يشير إلى power_name = 'Intelligence'؛
SQL: SELECT T1.hero_id FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

question_en: Give the eye colour of Blackwulf.
question_ar: أعطِ لون عين Blackwulf.
evidence_en: eye colour refers to colour.colour where eye_colour_id = colour.id; Blackwulf refers to superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';
evidence_ar: لون العين يشير إلى colour.colour حيث eye_colour_id = colour.id؛ Blackwulf يشير إلى superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'؛
SQL: SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'

question_en: List the power of superheroes with height greater than 80% of the average height of all superheroes.
question_ar: اذكر قوة الأبطال الخارقين الذين يزيد طولهم عن 80% من متوسط طول جميع الأبطال الخارقين.
evidence_en: power of superheroes refers to power_name; height greater than 80% of the average height of all superheroes = height_cm > MULTIPLY(AVG(height_cm), 0.8);
evidence_ar: قوة الأبطال الخارقين تشير إلى power_name؛ الطول أكبر من 80% من متوسط الطول = height_cm > (AVG(height_cm) * 0.8)؛
SQL: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.height_cm * 100 > ( SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero ) * 80

question_en: Please list the reference names of the drivers who are eliminated in the first period in race number 20.
question_ar: يرجى سرد الأسماء المرجعية للسائقين الذين تم إقصاؤهم في الفترة الأولى في السباق رقم 20.
evidence_en: driver reference name refers to driverRef; first qualifying period refers to q1; drivers who are eliminated in the first qualifying period refers to 5 drivers with MAX(q1); race number refers to raceId;
evidence_ar: الاسم المرجعي للسائق يشير إلى driverRef؛ الفترة التأهيلية الأولى تشير إلى q1؛ السائقون الذين تم إقصاؤهم في الفترة التأهيلية الأولى يشيرون إلى 5 سائقين لديهم الحد الأقصى لـ q1؛ رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛
SQL: SELECT T2.driverRef FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 20 ORDER BY T1.q1 DESC LIMIT 5

question_en: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
question_ar: ما هو لقب (surname) السائق الذي حقق أفضل وقت لفة في السباق رقم 19 في الفترة التأهيلية الثانية؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId; second qualifying period refers to q2; best lap time refers to MIN(q2);
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ الفترة التأهيلية الثانية تشير إلى q2؛ أفضل وقت لفة يشير إلى MIN(q2)؛
SQL: SELECT T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: Please list the year during which the race is held on circuits in Shanghai.
question_ar: يرجى ذكر السنة التي أقيم فيها السباق على حلبات في شنغهاي.
evidence_en: Shanghai is a name of location;
evidence_ar: شنغهاي هو اسم موقع (location)؛
SQL: SELECT T2.year FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.location = 'Shanghai'

question_en: Where can the introduction of the races held on Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya be found?
question_ar: أين يمكن العثور على مقدمة (رابط url) للسباقات التي أقيمت على حلبة برشلونة-كاتالونيا (Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya)؟
evidence_en: introduction of races refers to url; Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya is a name of circuit;
evidence_ar: مقدمة السباقات تشير إلى url؛ حلبة برشلونة-كاتالونيا هو اسم حلبة (circuit)؛
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.url FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.name = 'Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya'

question_en: Please give the name of the race held on the circuits in Germany.

evidence_en: Germany is a name of country;

question_en: Please list the positions of the circuits built by the constructor Renault.

question_en: How many races in the year 2010 are held on grand prixs outside Asia and Europe?

question_en: Please give the names of the races held on the circuits in Spain.

question_en: What is the coordinates location of the circuits for Australian grand prix?

SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

question_en: Where can I find the information about the races held on Sepang International Circuit?
question_ar: أين يمكنني العثور على معلومات حول السباقات التي تقام على حلبة سيبانغ الدولية (Sepang International Circuit)؟

question_en: Please list the time of the races held on Sepang International Circuit.
question_ar: يرجى سرد وقت (time) السباقات التي تقام على حلبة سيبانغ الدولية.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.time FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.name = 'Sepang International Circuit'

question_en: Give the coordinate position for Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.
question_ar: أعطِ موقع الإحداثيات (coordinate position) لسباق الجائزة الكبرى في أبو ظبي (Abu Dhabi Grand Prix).
evidence_en: coordinate position/location refers to lat, lng; Abu Dhabi Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
evidence_ar: موقع الإحداثيات يشير إلى lat, lng؛ سباق الجائزة الكبرى في أبو ظبي يشير إلى races.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'

question_en: Which country is the constructor which got 1 point in the race No. 24 from?
question_ar: من أي بلد (country) ينتمي المصنّع الذي حصل على نقطة واحدة في السباق رقم 24؟

question_en: What's Bruno Senna's Q1 result in the qualifying race No. 354?
question_ar: ما هي نتيجة (result) برونو سينا (Bruno Senna) في الربع الأول (Q1) في السباق التأهيلي رقم 354؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId; Bruno Senna refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ Bruno Senna يشير إلى الاسم الكامل للسائق؛ الاسم الكامل للسائق يشير إلى drivers.forename و drivers.surname؛
SQL: SELECT T1.q1 FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 354 AND T2.forename = 'Bruno' AND T2.surname = 'Senna'

question_en: For the driver who had the Q2 time as 0:01:40 in the qualifying race No. 355, what is his nationality?
question_ar: بالنسبة للسائق الذي كان وقته في الربع الثاني (Q2 time) 0:01:40 في السباق التأهيلي رقم 355، ما هي جنسيته (nationality)؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId;
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.nationality FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 355 AND T1.q2 LIKE '1:40%'

question_en: What is his number of the driver who finished 0:01:54 in the Q3 of qualifying race No.903?
question_ar: ما هو رقم (number) السائق الذي أنهى بوقت 0:01:54 في الربع الثالث (Q3) من السباق التأهيلي رقم 903؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId; finished 0:0M:SS in the Q3 refers to q3 LIKE 'M:SS%'
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ أنهى في 0:0M:SS في الربع الثالث يشير إلى q3 LIKE 'M:SS%'
SQL: SELECT T2.number FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 903 AND T1.q3 LIKE '1:54%'

question_en: For the Bahrain Grand Prix in 2007, how many drivers not finished the game?
question_ar: بالنسبة لسباق الجائزة الكبرى في البحرين عام 2007، كم عدد السائقين الذين لم ينهوا السباق (game)؟
evidence_en: Bahrain Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix'; drivers who finished the race refers to time is not empty (i.e. time IS NOT NULL);
evidence_ar: سباق الجائزة الكبرى في البحرين يشير إلى races.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix'؛ السائقون الذين أنهوا السباق يشيرون إلى أن الوقت ليس فارغًا (أي time IS NOT NULL)؛ بالتالي من لم ينهوا السباق وقتهم فارغ
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T3.driverId) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.year = 2007 AND T1.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND T2.time IS NULL

question_en: Show me the season page of year when the race No. 901 took place.
question_ar: أرني صفحة الموسم (season page) للسنة التي أقيم فيها السباق رقم 901.
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId;
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛
SQL: SELECT T2.url FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN seasons AS T2 ON T2.year = T1.year WHERE T1.raceId = 901

question_en: For the race happened on 2015/11/29, how many drivers finished the game?
question_ar: بالنسبة للسباق الذي حدث في 2015/11/29، كم عدد السائقين الذين أنهوا السباق (game)؟
evidence_en: game and race are synonyms; drivers who finished the race should have record in time;
evidence_ar: لعبة وسباق مترادفان؛ السائقون الذين أنهوا السباق يجب أن يكون لديهم سجل في الوقت (time)؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T2.driverId) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId WHERE T1.date = '2015-11-29' AND T2.time IS NOT NULL

question_en: For all the drivers who finished the game in race No. 592, who is the oldest?
question_ar: بالنسبة لجميع السائقين الذين أنهوا السباق في السباق رقم 592، من هو الأكبر سنًا (oldest)؟
evidence_en: drivers who finished the race refers to time is not empty (i.e. time IS NOT NULL); race number refers to raceId; date of birth refers to drivers.dob; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
evidence_ar: السائقون الذين أنهوا السباق يشيرون إلى أن الوقت ليس فارغًا (أي time IS NOT NULL)؛ رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ تاريخ الميلاد يشير إلى drivers.dob؛ كلما كانت قيمة عيد الميلاد أكبر، كان الشخص أصغر، والعكس صحيح؛
SQL: SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.raceId = 592 AND T2.time IS NOT NULL AND T1.dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.dob ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: Who was the player that got the lap time of 0:01:27 in the race No. 161? Show his introduction website.
question_ar: من هو اللاعب (السائق) الذي حصل على وقت لفة 0:01:27 في السباق رقم 161؟ أظهر موقعه التعريفي (introduction website).
evidence_en: player and driver are synonyms; the lap time of 0:0M:SS refers to lapTime.time LIKE 'M:SS%';race number refers to raceId; introduction website of the drivers refers to url;
evidence_ar: اللاعب والسائق مترادفان؛ وقت اللفة 0:0M:SS يشير إلى lapTime.time LIKE 'M:SS%'؛ رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ الموقع التعريفي للسائقين يشير إلى url؛
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.forename, T2.surname, T2.url FROM lapTimes AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 161 AND T1.time LIKE '1:27%'

question_en: For the driver who set the fastest lap speed in race No.933, where does he come from?
question_ar: بالنسبة للسائق الذي سجل أسرع سرعة لفة (fastest lap speed) في السباق رقم 933، من أين ينحدر (ما هي جنسيته)؟
evidence_en: fastest lap speed refers to MAX(fastestLapSpeed);
evidence_ar: أسرع سرعة لفة تشير إلى MAX(fastestLapSpeed)؛
SQL: SELECT T1.nationality FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.raceId = 933 AND T2.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T2.fastestLapSpeed DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: Where is Malaysian Grand Prix held? Give the location coordinates.
question_ar: أين يقام سباق الجائزة الكبرى الماليزي (Malaysian Grand Prix)؟ أعطِ إحداثيات الموقع (location coordinates).
evidence_en: location coordinates refers to (lat, lng); Malaysian Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
evidence_ar: إحداثيات الموقع تشير إلى (lat, lng)؛ سباق الجائزة الكبرى الماليزي يشير إلى races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

question_en: For the constructor which got the highest point in the race No. 9 , what is its introduction website?
question_ar: بالنسبة للمصنّع (constructor) الذي حصل على أعلى نقطة في السباق رقم 9، ما هو موقعه التعريفي (introduction website)؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId; constructor which got the highest point refers to MAX(constructorResults.points); introduction website of the constructor refers to url;
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ المصنّع الذي حصل على أعلى نقطة يشير إلى MAX(constructorResults.points)؛ الموقع التعريفي للمصنّع يشير إلى url؛
SQL: SELECT T2.url FROM constructorResults AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T2.constructorId = T1.constructorId WHERE T1.raceId = 9 ORDER BY T1.points DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: What's Lucas di Grassi's Q1 result in the race No. 345?
question_ar: ما هي نتيجة لوكاس دي غراسي (Lucas di Grassi) في الربع الأول (Q1) في السباق رقم 345؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId;
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛
SQL: SELECT T1.q1 FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 345 AND T2.forename = 'Lucas' AND T2.surname = 'di Grassi'

question_en: For the driver who had the Q2 time as 0:01:15 in race No. 347, where is he from?
question_ar: بالنسبة للسائق الذي كان وقته في الربع الثاني (Q2) 0:01:15 في السباق رقم 347، من أين هو (ما هي جنسيته)؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId;
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.nationality FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 347 AND T1.q2 LIKE '1:15%'

question_en: In the race No. 45, for the driver who had the Q3 time as 0:01:33, what is his abbreviated code?
question_ar: في السباق رقم 45، بالنسبة للسائق الذي كان وقته في الربع الثالث (Q3) 0:01:33، ما هو رمزه المختصر (abbreviated code)؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId; had the Q3 time as 0:0M:SS refers to q3 LIKE 'M:SS%'
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ وقته في الربع الثالث 0:0M:SS يشير إلى q3 LIKE 'M:SS%'
SQL: SELECT T2.code FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 45 AND T1.q3 LIKE '1:33%'

question_en: What is the actual finish time for Bruce McLaren in the race No.743?
question_ar: ما هو وقت الإنهاء الفعلي لـ Bruce McLaren في السباق رقم 743؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId;
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛
SQL: SELECT T2.time FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.raceId = 743 AND T1.forename = 'Bruce' AND T1.surname = 'McLaren'

question_en: Who finished second in the San Marino Grand Prix in 2006?
question_ar: من أنهى في المركز الثاني في سباق الجائزة الكبرى في سان مارينو عام 2006؟
evidence_en: finished second refers to position = 2;
evidence_ar: أنهى في المركز الثاني تشير إلى position = 2؛
SQL: SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.year = 2006 AND T1.name = 'San Marino Grand Prix' AND T2.position = 2

question_en: For the race happened in 2015/11/29, how many drivers did not finish the game?
question_ar: بالنسبة للسباق الذي أقيم في 2015/11/29، كم عدد السائقين الذين لم ينهوا السباق (game)؟
evidence_en: game and race are synonyms; drivers who didn't finish the race should have record in time;
evidence_ar: لعبة وسباق مترادفان؛ السائقون الذين لم ينهوا السباق يجب أن يكون لديهم سجل فارغ في الوقت (time)؛
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T2.driverId) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId WHERE T1.date = '2015-11-29' AND T2.time IS NULL

question_en: For all the drivers who finished the game in race No. 872, who is the youngest?
question_ar: من بين جميع السائقين الذين أنهوا السباق في السباق رقم 872، من هو الأصغر سنًا؟
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId; drivers who finished the race refers to time has value; the youngest is a driver where MAX(dob);
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ السائقون الذين أنهوا السباق يشيرون إلى أن الوقت له قيمة؛ الأصغر سنًا هو سائق لديه الحد الأقصى لتاريخ الميلاد MAX(dob)؛
SQL: SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.raceId = 872 AND T2.time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.dob DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: Who was the driver that got the best lap time in the race No. 348? Give his full name.
question_ar: من هو السائق الذي حقق أفضل وقت لفة في السباق رقم 348؟ أعطِ اسمه الكامل.
evidence_en: race number refers to raceId; the best lap time refers to MIN(time)
evidence_ar: رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ أفضل وقت لفة يشير إلى MIN(time)
SQL: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname FROM lapTimes AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 348 ORDER BY T1.time ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: For the driver who set the fastest lap speed, what is his nationality?
question_ar: ما هي جنسية السائق الذي سجل أسرع سرعة لفة (fastest lap speed)؟
evidence_en: the fastest lap speed refers to (MAX) fastestLapSpeed;
evidence_ar: أسرع سرعة لفة تشير إلى (الحد الأقصى) fastestLapSpeed؛
SQL: SELECT T1.nationality FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId ORDER BY T2.fastestLapSpeed DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: Paul di Resta was in the No. 853 race, what percent faster did he finish in the 853rd race than the next race for the fastest lap speed?
question_ar: شارك Paul di Resta في السباق رقم 853، ما هي النسبة المئوية التي كان فيها أسرع في السباق 853 مقارنة بالسباق التالي (854) من حيث أسرع سرعة لفة؟
evidence_en: Paul di Resta refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename ='Paul' and drivers.surname = 'di Resta'; race number refers to raceId; percentage = DIVIDE(SUBTRACT(fastestLapSpeed(raceId = 853), (fastestLapSpeed (raceId = 854)) * 100 , (fastestLapSpeed(raceId = 853))
evidence_ar: Paul di Resta يشير إلى الاسم الكامل للسائق؛ الاسم الكامل للسائق يشير إلى drivers.forename ='Paul' و drivers.surname = 'di Resta'؛ رقم السباق يشير إلى raceId؛ النسبة المئوية = (سرعة السباق 853 - سرعة السباق 854) * 100 / سرعة السباق 853
SQL: SELECT (SUM(IIF(T2.raceId = 853, T2.fastestLapSpeed, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.raceId = 854, T2.fastestLapSpeed, 0))) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T2.raceId = 853, T2.fastestLapSpeed, 0)) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.forename = 'Paul' AND T1.surname = 'di Resta'

question_en: For the drivers who took part in the race in 1983/7/16, what's their race completion rate?
question_ar: بالنسبة للسائقين الذين شاركوا في السباق يوم 1983/7/16، ما هو معدل إكمالهم للسباق؟
evidence_en: DIVIDE(COUNT(driverid when time has value ), (COUNT(driverid )) as percentage; in 1983/7/16 refers to when date = '1983-07-16'
evidence_ar: النسبة المئوية = قسمة(عدد(driverid عندما يكون للوقت قيمة)، عدد(driverid))؛ في 1983/7/16 يشير إلى date = '1983-07-16'
SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.time IS NOT NULL THEN T2.driverId END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.driverId) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId WHERE T1.date = '1983-07-16'

question_en: Which year was the first Singapore Grand Prix?
question_ar: في أي عام كان أول سباق جائزة كبرى في سنغافورة (Singapore Grand Prix)؟
evidence_en: the first race refers to race happened in min(year);
evidence_ar: السباق الأول يشير إلى السباق الذي حدث في الحد الأدنى للسنة min(year)؛
SQL: SELECT year FROM races WHERE name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: How many races were there in 2005? Name all the races in descending order.
question_ar: كم عدد السباقات التي كانت في عام 2005؟ اذكر أسماء جميع السباقات بترتيب تنازلي.
SQL: SELECT name FROM races WHERE year = 2005 ORDER BY name DESC

question_en: List the names of all races that occurred in the earliest recorded year and month.
question_ar: اذكر أسماء جميع السباقات التي حدثت في أقدم سنة وشهر مسجلين.
evidence_en: earliest recorded year and month refers to year = year(min(date)) and month = month(min(date));
evidence_ar: أقدم سنة وشهر مسجلين يشير إلى السنة = سنة(الحد الأدنى(date)) والشهر = شهر(الحد الأدنى(date))؛
SQL: SELECT name FROM races WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = ( SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', date) FROM races ORDER BY date ASC LIMIT 1 ) AND STRFTIME('%m', date) = ( SELECT STRFTIME('%m', date) FROM races ORDER BY date ASC LIMIT 1 )

question_en: State the name and date of the last round of race in year 1999.
question_ar: اذكر اسم وتاريخ الجولة الأخيرة من السباق في عام 1999.
evidence_en: the last round refers to max(round);
evidence_ar: الجولة الأخيرة تشير إلى الحد الأقصى للجولة max(round)؛
SQL: SELECT name, date FROM races WHERE year = 1999 ORDER BY round DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: Which year has the most number of races?
question_ar: أي سنة بها أكبر عدد من السباقات؟
evidence_en: the most number of races refers to max(round);
evidence_ar: أكبر عدد من السباقات يشير إلى الحد الأقصى لعدد الجولات (أو السباقات) لكل سنة؛
SQL: SELECT year FROM races GROUP BY year ORDER BY COUNT(round) DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: Name the races in year 2017 that are not hosted in year 2000.
question_ar: اذكر أسماء السباقات في عام 2017 التي لم تتم استضافتها في عام 2000.
evidence_en: not hosted means not in;
evidence_ar: لم تتم استضافتها تعني ليست في (not in)؛
SQL: SELECT name FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND name NOT IN ( SELECT name FROM races WHERE year = 2000 )

question_en: In which country was the first European Grand Prix hosted? Name the circuit and location.
question_ar: في أي دولة تمت استضافة أول سباق جائزة كبرى أوروبي (European Grand Prix)؟ اذكر اسم الحلبة (circuit) والموقع (location).
evidence_en: the first refers to min(year);
evidence_ar: الأول يشير إلى الحد الأدنى للسنة min(year)؛
SQL: SELECT T1.country, T1.location FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'European Grand Prix' ORDER BY T2.year ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: When was the last f1 season whereby Brands Hatch hosted the British Grand Prix?
question_ar: متى كان آخر موسم لـ f1 حيث استضافت حلبة Brands Hatch سباق الجائزة الكبرى البريطاني (British Grand Prix)؟ (المطلوب التاريخ)
evidence_en: the last refers to max(year);
evidence_ar: الأخير يشير إلى الحد الأقصى للسنة max(year)؛ (الاستعلام يعيد التاريخ date)
SQL: SELECT T2.date FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.name = 'Brands Hatch' AND T2.name = 'British Grand Prix' ORDER BY T2.year DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: How many seasons has Silverstone Circuit hosted the United Kindom grand prix?
question_ar: كم عدد المواسم التي استضافت فيها حلبة سيلفرستون (Silverstone Circuit) سباق الجائزة الكبرى في المملكة المتحدة؟
evidence_en: British Grand Prix is the name of race; British refers to the United Kindom
evidence_ar: سباق الجائزة الكبرى البريطاني هو اسم السباق؛ بريطاني يشير إلى المملكة المتحدة
SQL: SELECT COUNT(T2.circuitid) FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.name = 'Silverstone Circuit' AND T2.name = 'British Grand Prix'

question_en: Name all drivers in the 2010 Singapore Grand Prix order by their position stands.
question_ar: اذكر جميع السائقين في سباق الجائزة الكبرى في سنغافورة لعام 2010 مرتبين حسب مراكزهم (position).
SQL: SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' AND T1.year = 2010 ORDER BY T2.position ASC

question_en: State the driver with the most points scored. Find his full name with that points.
question_ar: اذكر السائق الذي سجل أكبر عدد من النقاط. أوجد اسمه الكامل مع تلك النقاط.
evidence_en: the most points scored refers to max(points); Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;
evidence_ar: أكبر عدد من النقاط المسجلة يشير إلى الحد الأقصى للنقاط max(points)؛ الاسم الكامل للسائق يشير إلى drivers.forename و drivers.surname؛
SQL: SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname, T2.points FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId ORDER BY T2.points DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: Name the top 3 drivers and the points they scored in the 2017 Chinese Grand Prix.
question_ar: اذكر أفضل 3 سائقين والنقاط التي سجلوها في سباق الجائزة الكبرى الصيني (Chinese Grand Prix) لعام 2017.
SQL: SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname, T2.points FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND T1.year = 2017 ORDER BY T2.points DESC LIMIT 3

question_en: What is the best lap time recorded? List the driver and race with such recorded lap time.
question_ar: ما هو أفضل وقت لفة مسجل؟ اذكر السائق والسباق الذي تم فيه تسجيل وقت اللفة هذا.
evidence_en: the best lap time refers to min(milliseconds); List the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; List the race refers to races.name
evidence_ar: أفضل وقت لفة يشير إلى الحد الأدنى للملي ثانية min(milliseconds)؛ اذكر السائق يشير إلى drivers.forename و drivers.surname؛ اذكر السباق يشير إلى races.name
SQL: SELECT T2.milliseconds, T1.forename, T1.surname, T3.name FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId ORDER BY T2.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: What is the average lap time for Lewis Hamilton in the 2009 Malaysian Grand Prix?
question_ar: ما هو متوسط وقت اللفة لويس هاميلتون (Lewis Hamilton) في سباق الجائزة الكبرى الماليزي لعام 2009؟
evidence_en: average lap time = AVG(milliseconds); 'Lewis Hamilton' refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; 'Malaysian Grand Prix' refers to races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
evidence_ar: متوسط وقت اللفة = AVG(milliseconds)؛ 'Lewis Hamilton' يشير إلى الاسم الكامل للسائق؛ الاسم الكامل للسائق يشير إلى drivers.forename و drivers.surname؛ 'Malaysian Grand Prix' يشير إلى races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
SQL: SELECT AVG(T2.milliseconds) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Lewis' AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.year = 2009 AND T1.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

question_en: Calculate the percentage whereby Hamilton was not at the 1st track of the the f1 circuit since 2010.
question_ar: احسب النسبة المئوية التي لم يكن فيها هاميلتون (Hamilton) في المركز الأول في ترتيب السائقين منذ عام 2010.
evidence_en: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(raceId) where surname = 'Hamilton' and position>1), (COUNT(raceId) where surname = 'Hamilton'); since 2010 refers to year >= 2010
evidence_ar: النسبة المئوية = قسمة(عدد(raceId) حيث surname = 'Hamilton' و position>1)، (عدد(raceId) حيث surname = 'Hamilton')؛ منذ 2010 يشير إلى year >= 2010
SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.position <> 1 THEN T2.position END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.driverStandingsId) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.year >= 2010

question_en: Name the driver with the most winning. Mention his nationality and what is his maximum point scores.
question_ar: اذكر السائق الذي حقق أكبر عدد من الانتصارات (winning). اذكر جنسيته وما هو الحد الأقصى للنقاط التي سجلها.
evidence_en: Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; the most winning refers to MAX(COUNT(wins)); average point scores refers to MAX(points);
evidence_ar: الاسم الكامل للسائق يشير إلى drivers.forename و drivers.surname؛ أكبر عدد من الانتصارات يشير إلى السائق الذي لديه أكبر عدد من السجلات التي فيها wins >= 1 (كما في الاستعلام)؛ الحد الأقصى للنقاط يشير إلى MAX(points)؛
SQL: SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality, MAX(T2.points) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.wins >= 1 GROUP BY T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality ORDER BY COUNT(T2.wins) DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: How old is the youngest Japanese driver? What is his name?
question_ar: كم عمر أصغر سائق ياباني؟ ما اسمه؟
evidence_en: date of birth refers to drivers.dob; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; Japanese refers to nationality = 'Japanese'; age = YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(dob);
evidence_ar: تاريخ الميلاد يشير إلى drivers.dob؛ كلما كان تاريخ الميلاد أكبر (أحدث)، كان الشخص أصغر سناً؛ ياباني يشير إلى nationality = 'Japanese'؛ العمر = سنة(الوقت الحالي) - سنة(تاريخ الميلاد)؛
SQL: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', dob), forename , surname FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: List circuits which host 4 f1 races from year 1990 to 2000.
question_ar: اذكر الحلبات (circuits) التي استضافت 4 سباقات f1 من عام 1990 إلى 2000.
evidence_en: from year 1990 to 2000 refers to year(date) between 1990 and 2000;
evidence_ar: من عام 1990 إلى 2000 يشير إلى سنة(date) بين 1990 و 2000؛
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) BETWEEN '1990' AND '2000' GROUP BY T1.name HAVING COUNT(T2.raceId) = 4

question_en: List circuits in USA which hosted f1 races in 2006. State the name and location of circuit and the name of the race it hosted.
question_ar: اذكر الحلبات في الولايات المتحدة (USA) التي استضافت سباقات f1 في عام 2006. اذكر اسم وموقع الحلبة واسم السباق الذي استضافته.
SQL: SELECT T1.name, T1.location, T2.name FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.country = 'USA' AND T2.year = 2006

question_en: Name the races along with its circuit name and location for f1 races hosted in September 2005.
question_ar: اذكر أسماء السباقات مع اسم الحلبة وموقعها لسباقات f1 التي أقيمت في سبتمبر 2005.
evidence_en: in September 2005 refers to MONTH(date) = 9 and YEAR(date) = 2005
evidence_ar: في سبتمبر 2005 يشير إلى شهر(date) = '09' وسنة(date) = 2005
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name, T1.name, T1.location FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.year = 2005 AND STRFTIME('%m', T2.date) = '09'

question_en: Which race was Alex Yoong in when he was in track number less than 20?
question_ar: في أي سباق كان أليكس يونغ (Alex Yoong) عندما كان في مركز (position) أقل من 20؟
evidence_en: Alex Yoong refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;track number less than 10 refers to position < 20
evidence_ar: Alex Yoong يشير إلى الاسم الكامل للسائق؛ الاسم الكامل للسائق يشير إلى drivers.forename و drivers.surname؛ مركز أقل من 20 يشير إلى position < 20
SQL: SELECT T1.name FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Alex' AND T3.surname = 'Yoong' AND T2.position < 20

question_en: How many times did Michael Schumacher won from races hosted in Sepang International Circuit?
question_ar: كم مرة فاز مايكل شوماخر (Michael Schumacher) في سباقات أقيمت في حلبة سيبانغ الدولية (Sepang International Circuit)؟
evidence_en: win from races refers to max(points)
evidence_ar: الفوز بالسباقات يشير إلى الحد الأقصى للنقاط (أو في هذه الحالة الاستعلام يجمع الانتصارات T2.wins)
SQL: SELECT SUM(T2.wins) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T4 ON T4.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T1.forename = 'Michael' AND T1.surname = 'Schumacher' AND T4.name = 'Sepang International Circuit'

question_en: State the race and year of race in which Michael Schumacher had his fastest lap.
question_ar: اذكر السباق وسنة السباق الذي حقق فيه مايكل شوماخر أسرع لفة له.
evidence_en: fastest lap refers to min(milliseconds); Alex Yoong refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;
evidence_ar: أسرع لفة تشير إلى الحد الأدنى من المللي ثانية؛ مايكل شوماخر يشير إلى الاسم الكامل للسائق (forename و surname)؛
SQL: SELECT T1.name, T1.year FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Michael' AND T3.surname = 'Schumacher' ORDER BY T2.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: What is Eddie Irvine's average points scored in year 2000?
question_ar: ما هو متوسط النقاط التي سجلها إيدي إيرفين (Eddie Irvine) في عام 2000؟
evidence_en: average points = AVG(points where year = 2000)
evidence_ar: متوسط النقاط = AVG(points) حيث السنة = 2000؛
SQL: SELECT AVG(T2.points) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.forename = 'Eddie' AND T1.surname = 'Irvine' AND T3.year = 2000

question_en: Which was Lewis Hamilton first race? What was his points recorded for his first race event?
question_ar: ما هو أول سباق للويس هاميلتون (Lewis Hamilton)؟ وما هي النقاط التي سجلها في حدث سباقه الأول؟
evidence_en: first race refers to min(Year); Lewis Hamiltonrefers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;
evidence_ar: السباق الأول يشير إلى السنة الأقل (min(Year) أو ترتيب تصاعدي للسنة)؛ لويس هاميلتون يشير إلى الاسم الكامل للسائق؛
SQL: SELECT T1.name, T2.points FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Lewis' AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY T1.year ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: List all races in 2017 and the hosting country order by date of the event.
question_ar: اذكر جميع السباقات في عام 2017 والبلد المضيف مرتبة حسب تاريخ الحدث.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name, T1.country FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.year = 2017 ORDER BY T2.date ASC

question_en: What is the most laps f1 races had? Name the race, year and circuit location where the races with most laps was hosted.
question_ar: ما هو أكبر عدد من اللفات (laps) في سباقات f1؟ اذكر السباق، والسنة، وموقع الحلبة حيث أقيم السباق الذي يحتوي على أكبر عدد من اللفات.
SQL: SELECT T3.lap, T2.name, T2.year, T1.location FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId ORDER BY T3.lap DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: Among all European Grand Prix races, what is the percentage of the races were hosted in Germany?
question_ar: من بين جميع سباقات الجائزة الكبرى الأوروبية (European Grand Prix)، ما هي النسبة المئوية للسباقات التي أقيمت في ألمانيا؟
evidence_en: European Grand Prix races refers to races.name = 'European Grand Prix';percentage = divide(COUNT(races where country = Germany and name = 'Europearn Grand Prix'),COUNT(races where name = 'Europearn Grand Prix'))*100
evidence_ar: سباقات الجائزة الكبرى الأوروبية تشير إلى races.name = 'European Grand Prix'؛ النسبة = قسمة(عدد السباقات في ألمانيا واسمها الجائزة الكبرى الأوروبية) على (إجمالي سباقات الجائزة الكبرى الأوروبية) * 100
SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.country = 'Germany' THEN T2.circuitID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.circuitId) FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'European Grand Prix'

question_en: What's the location coordinates of Silverstone Circuit?
question_ar: ما هي إحداثيات موقع حلبة سيلفرستون (Silverstone Circuit)؟
evidence_en: location coordinates refers to (lat, lng); Silverstone Circuit refers to circuits.name = 'Silverstone Circuit'
evidence_ar: إحداثيات الموقع تشير إلى (lat, lng)؛ حلبة سيلفرستون تشير إلى circuits.name = 'Silverstone Circuit'
SQL: SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Silverstone Circuit'

question_en: Which of these circuits is located at a higher latitude, Silverstone Circuit, Hockenheimring or Hungaroring?
question_ar: أي من هذه الحلبات يقع على خط عرض أعلى (higher latitude): حلبة سيلفرستون، هوكنهايمرينغ أم المجر؟
evidence_en: higher latitude refers to max(lat)
evidence_ar: خط عرض أعلى يشير إلى الحد الأقصى (lat) ترتيب تنازلي
SQL: SELECT name FROM circuits WHERE name IN ('Silverstone Circuit', 'Hockenheimring', 'Hungaroring') ORDER BY lat DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: What's the reference name of Marina Bay Street Circuit?
question_ar: ما هو الاسم المرجعي (reference name) لحلبة شارع مارينا باي (Marina Bay Street Circuit)؟
evidence_en: reference name refers to circuitRef; Marina Bay Street Circuit refers to circuits.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
evidence_ar: الاسم المرجعي يشير إلى circuitRef؛ حلبة شارع مارينا باي تشير إلى circuits.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
SQL: SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'

question_en: In which country can I find the circuit with the highest altitude?
question_ar: في أي بلد يمكنني العثور على الحلبة ذات الارتفاع الأعلى (highest altitude)؟
evidence_en: highest altitude refers to max(alt)
evidence_ar: الارتفاع الأعلى يشير إلى الترتيب التنازلي حسب (alt)
SQL: SELECT country FROM circuits ORDER BY alt DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: How many drivers don't have a code?
question_ar: كم عدد السائقين الذين ليس لديهم رمز (code)؟
evidence_en: don't have a code refers to code is null
evidence_ar: ليس لديهم رمز يشير إلى أن الرمز فارغ (null)؛
